**Biodôme**
- 
Espace pour la vie's schedule page lists the Biodôme at 9 a.m.–5 p.m. for the week of October 12, 2026.

- 
All Espace pour la vie museums are closed on December 24 and 25.
 That falls before the visit.
- A Montréal museums listing shows 
the regular schedule from Sep 2 to Apr 30 with Monday closed.
 Dec 28 is a Monday, so ring ahead for that day.
- No price was read off the venue's own page.

**Science Centre**
- 
Its own post gives 9 a.m.–4 p.m. Monday to Friday and 10 a.m.–5 p.m. on Saturdays and Sundays.

- That post dates from the fall, not the holidays.
- The only holiday-hours page on its own site is an old one for a past year, so I didn't use it.
- A listing site shows 10 a.m.–5 p.m. for Dec 26–30, but it isn't the venue's page.
- No price was read off the venue's own page.

**Not included.** I did not find any toddler programs or playgrounds with their own posted hours for those dates.
